blocks.description: A While block with two statements inside. The two simple statements have a semicolon marked in green; the opening and closing lines have none, marked with an empty-set symbol in red.

caption.text: A semicolon at the end of every simple statement; none on the opening and closing lines of a block.

runs.text: Several statements can share a line if each has its semicolon. Empty lines produce no statement.
